items.q: Is the station really open at night?
items.a: Yes, Autonet 80 is self-service 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, Sundays and bank holidays included. If a bay is closed for maintenance, we post it at the top of this site.
At the pay station, no booking needed. Bank cards and coins are accepted (to be confirmed). The price is shown on each pay station before you start.
About 5 minutes for a quick high-pressure wash, 15 minutes for a full wash with vacuuming, and 25 minutes if you also wash the mats.

items.q: Can I wash a van or a motorhome?
items.a: The bays are wide and suit SUVs and vans. For a tall or very long vehicle, call us before you come and we'll tell you which bay to use.

items.q: A machine isn't working. What should I do?
items.a: Report it in one click with the contact form (reason: "Machine fault") or on WhatsApp, saying which bay or pay station. We'll sort it out as quickly as we can.

items.q: Do you have rates for businesses?
items.a: Yes, for companies that regularly wash several vehicles. Tell us about your fleet and how often you need it, and we'll make you an offer (to be confirmed).

camon.metaDescription: Autonet 80, the self-service car wash in Camon: high-pressure jet wash, foaming brush, vacuums, mat washer. Open 24/7, 424 rue Édouard Branly.
camon.intro: Autonet 80 is the self-service car wash in Camon, on rue Édouard Branly. You wash the car yourself, at your own pace, with well-kept machines and clearly displayed prices.

sections.p: High-pressure wash bays with pre-wash, foaming brush and rinse, powerful vacuums, a mat washer and a vending machine for cleaning products.

sections.h: Easy to reach from Camon and Rivery
sections.p: The station is in the Camon business park, with direct access by car. The bays are wide, and the vacuums have their own spots so nobody blocks the wash bays.
No opening hours to remember: the station is open 24/7. In the evening and early morning there's rarely a queue.

h24.metaDescription: High-pressure car wash open 24/7 near Amiens, in Camon. Vacuums, mat washer, foaming brush. Rated 4.5/5 on Google from 91 reviews.
h24.intro: Need to wash the car late at night or on a Sunday morning? Autonet 80 in Camon is open day and night, about ten minutes from central Amiens.

sections.p: Pre-wash, wash and rinse with the jet, plus the foaming brush: combine the programmes as you like and only pay for the time you use.
From central Amiens, head east towards Camon. The station is at 424 rue Édouard Branly, in the business park.
Even at night, you can report a fault in one click on WhatsApp. The message reaches us with the bay or pay station concerned.
